read.thesis: Q3 USG 5.2% on 2.9% volume and 2.3% price, with Emerging Markets 9.5% and Foods flat; FY26 volume guide raised to at least 3%, but no capacity or capex data disclosed.

triggers.label: FY26 volume guide raised to at least 3%
triggers.quote: we now expect at least 3% underlying volume growth for full year 2026 and underlying sales growth in the second half of around 5%

triggers.label: Price growth stepped up to 2.3%
triggers.quote: Underlying price growth stepped up as planned in the third quarter reflecting higher commodity costs, in particular in Home Care and Personal Care.
triggers.highlight: Underlying price growth stepped up as planned

triggers.label: Emerging markets USG 9.5%
triggers.quote: Emerging Markets: 9.5% USG, with strong volume growth of 6.0% and 3.3% from price.

guidance.quote: we now expect at least 3% underlying volume growth for full year 2026

guidance.value: within 4% to 6% multi-year range; H2 around 5%
guidance.quote: We continue to expect underlying sales growth for full year 2026 to be within our multi-year guidance range of 4% to 6%
modest improvement in underlying operating margin for the full year versus 20.0% in 2025

red_flags.label: Foods developed-market retail decline and US condiments competition
red_flags.quote: Growth in emerging markets and in Foods Solutions was offset by a decline in developed market retail, reflecting continued softer market conditions and increased competition in US condiments.

red_flags.label: Wellbeing down (1.0)% YTD, private label entry in club
red_flags.quote: Liquid I.V.’s international expansion and continued share gains in the mass retail and online channels were offset by reduced distribution and the entry of private label in the club channel.
